what: Curated defensive effects — what a champion's own kit does to damage they RECEIVE, copied verbatim from the protected override file. Each states its own verification status.

provenance.source: curated/curated-data.json (the protected override file)
provenance.warning: ALMOST EVERY ENTRY IS CONDITIONAL, and the engine cannot know whether a defence was up. The user states that in the scenario, keyed by defensiveToggleKey() from src/types/. ABSENT MEANS NOT UP — asserting a defence nobody stated would understate the damage. An entry marked incomplete contributes nothing and says why (SPECIFICATION §8).
